title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Payment Methods Notice: Automatic-Payment Credit on Payment Plans
content:
## Payment methods notice: automatic-payment credit

**Notice.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, an automatic-payment credit is taken off the financed amount when a credit, debit or HSA/FSA card is on file: 5.00 when two or more automatic refill orders were placed less than 12 whole months before the handling date, 2.50 when exactly one was, and nothing when none was or when no card is on file.

"On file" is the payment method recorded on the home delivery account; automatic refill orders are placed orders whose origin is an automatic refill.

### Credit table

| Card on file | Automatic refill orders placed less than 12 whole months before the handling date | Credit taken off the financed amount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 2 or more | 5.00 |
| Yes | exactly 1 | 2.50 |
| Yes | none | nothing |
| No | any | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases

- HSA/FSA card on file, three automatic refill orders in the last year: 5.00.
- Credit card on file, one automatic refill order eight months ago: 2.50.
- No card on file, four automatic refill orders: nothing.
